verdict.rationale: a-Shell provides a Unix-like terminal with grep availability (shown via "help -l | grep command") and Vim for in-file search, implying basic regex text search, but there is no evidence of fuzzy-matching tools (fzf, ripgrep, ag) or advanced code-search/filtering features. missing for 10: fuzzy matching tool, dedicated code search/filter utility, and documentation of regex-based multi-file search workflow.
